name: Ziva Shani
source: Ciarán's schoolmate with a bright and charming personality. Ziva is a beauty and really popular with the boys (and some girls) even though it seems she doesn't really pay much attention to those things. Dreams of becoming a psychologist and treats Ciarán as her patient due his habit of writing and his bad attitude. She talks a lot, and usually ends up trying to psychoanalyze everything, with a tendency to push people to do what she wants.
